messages.author: Wim R. Cardoen
messages.body:
Hello,
I wonder whether the amber website is down.
amber20]$ ./configure intel
Checking for updates...
Checking for available patches online. This may take a few seconds...
NoInternetAccess: Cannot connect to https://ambermd.org
Check for updates failed.
Thanks,
Wim

messages.author: Gustaf Olsson
messages.body:
Though it is not unreasonable that the website/server might be down it is as likely that this is the effect of firewall rules/filtering.
Best regards
// Gustaf

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Jul 20, 2020, Wim R. Cardoen wrote:
>
>I wonder whether the amber website is down.
Works for me, and the update_amber command works.
In the amber20_src folder, try running './update_amber --check-updates'
It's worth a second try, in case the problem was intermittent. (Of course,
make sure you browser can access
https://ambermd.org
.)
....dac
